summary: The additive financial, notification-action and image-upload boundaries pass targeted emulator tests. This scoped prototype review does not certify the entire existing rule set or a live deployment.

findings.issue: Legacy admins without shopScopes retain broad catalogue, fulfillment and customer authority. Finance and broadcast remain separate server claims.
findings.recommendation: Provision explicit shopScopes through authorized identity administration, refresh tokens and verify the staff access matrix before broad rollout. Never accept authority from profile fields.

resolvedFindings: Storage overwrite testing showed allow create alone was insufficient; resource == null now enforces immutable originals.
Client-created legacy requests cannot mutate new paid-order, inventory, refund, transaction or reusable-authorization state.
Notification recipient, canonical reply target, blocks and active public-community membership are rechecked; repeated Like/Reply has one effect.
A delayed duplicate payment webhook after partial refund no longer reallocates stock or overwrites the refund state.

checks.updateBypass: Financial reads/writes denied even to admin client SDK claims; only recipient notification read updates permitted.
checks.authority: Server claims and canonical records; hiding UI is not authorization.
checks.bounds: Money, quantities, address input, upload bytes/pixels/workers, notification queues/attempts and render contracts bounded.
checks.types: Server input validation; MIME declaration plus signature plus real decoder validation.
checks.ownership: Private customer/authorization projections are callable-only; asset owner paths and render ownership/revision/fingerprint enforced.
